features.name: any_quote_response_block_comment
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain a blockquote line followed by non-quoted reply text?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as JSON list of strings; malformed/missing -> null; empty list -> 0. For each comment, split into lines (after replacing '>' at line start with '>'). A comment qualifies if some line matches regex ^\s*>\s*\S (blockquote) and a later line (after that line) exists that is non-empty and does not start with '>' (reply text). Output 1 if any comment qualifies else 0. Mechanical on raw text; no semantic filtering; text may contain outcome announcements.

features.name: share_quote_response_block_comments
features.definition: What share of counter-argument comments contain a blockquote line followed by non-quoted reply text?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments JSON list; malformed/missing -> null; empty list -> null. Qualifying comment as defined: after replacing line-initial '>' with '>', has a line matching ^\s*>\s*\S followed later by a non-empty line not starting with '>'. Value = qualifying comments / total comments. Raw-text mechanical; no semantic filtering.

h0: share_quote_response_block_comments has no association with delta.
h1: Higher share_quote_response_block_comments is associated with lower likelihood of delta.
note: Operationalised structured quote-response as Markdown blockquote (> or >) followed by non-quoted text in the same comment. Persuasiveness is operationalised as the dataset outcome delta (association only). The hypothesis does not specify any-vs-share; share is the primary term, any-comment feature is an alternative measure. Comments are unordered, no timing; raw text may contain view-change announcements (not filtered). Rows with no comments get null for share.
